name: SoFiUSD
oneLiner: SoFiUSD is SoFi Bank's USD stablecoin, fully reserved by cash at the bank's Federal Reserve master account; minted and redeemed 1:1 via BitGo infrastructure.
collateral: 1:1 USD reserves held as cash or cash equivalents at SoFi Bank's Federal Reserve master account; reserves earn interest on reserve balances (IORB) retained by SoFi, not passed to holders
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redeem via BitGo infrastructure; instant conversions between dollars and SOFID

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

applicabilityBasis.summary: SOFID is a U.S. dollar payment stablecoin issued by SoFi Bank, N.A. with 1:1 mint and redemption.

OCC SoFi Bank approval and charter materials
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for SOFID.

mintAuthority.summary: SOFID is issued by SoFi Bank, N.A. (OCC-chartered) with BitGo Bank & Trust providing Stablecoin-as-a-Service; mint, burn, custody, and smart-contract management run through BitGo's centralized infrastructure against 1:1 USD reserves.

controls.label: BitGo issuance backend (Stablecoin-as-a-Service for SoFi)
controls.evidence: BitGo Bank & Trust operates mint, burn, custody, and smart-contract management for SOFID on behalf of issuer SoFi Bank; supply is created 1:1 against cash at SoFi's Federal Reserve master account. No permissionless mint route.

sources.label: BitGo selected by SoFi to provide stablecoin infrastructure

review.evidence: SoFi Bank, N.A. is the issuer; BitGo Bank & Trust provides the mint/burn/custody/smart-contract-management plumbing per BitGo's announcement. Centralized issuer-controlled mint against bank-held reserves, no permissionless path.

sources.label: BitGo selected by SoFi to provide stablecoin infrastructure

review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer/operator mint model confirmed from BitGo and SoFi first-party materials; on-chain token owner/minter admin not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain SOFID token owner/minter admin (BitGo-managed contract) and proxy admin before raising to verified.

reserves.name: USD cash and cash equivalents at SoFi Bank Federal Reserve master account

featuredContent.title: SoFi unveils first bank-issued stablecoin for enterprise payments
featuredContent.description: SoFi Bank becomes the first nationally chartered U.S. bank to issue a stablecoin on a public blockchain, targeting enterprise settlement.

featuredContent.title: SoFiUSD to launch on Solana, citing speed and cost
featuredContent.description: SoFi announces Solana expansion at Solana Accelerate Miami, May 5, 2026.

milestones.title: SoFiUSD launches as first nationally chartered U.S. bank stablecoin
milestones.description: SoFi Bank, N.A. issues SOFID on Ethereum; 1:1 backed by cash at Federal Reserve master account; initially for enterprise settlement, not consumer-facing.

milestones.title: Mastercard partnership for SoFiUSD settlement across global payments network
milestones.description: Card issuers and acquirers can settle transactions using SoFiUSD 24/7 via Mastercard's Multi-Token Network (MTN) across 200+ countries.

milestones.title: BitGo selected as infrastructure and distribution partner
milestones.description: BitGo Bank & Trust provides Stablecoin-as-a-Service: minting, burning, custody, smart contract management, and distribution.

milestones.title: SoFi launches Big Business Banking platform integrating SoFiUSD and Solana
milestones.description: Enterprise banking platform with SOFID settlement; BitGo Mint launches with SoFiUSD as first supported stablecoin alongside USD1.

milestones.title: SoFiUSD expansion to Solana announced at Solana Accelerate Miami
milestones.description: Solana deployment in progress; retail rollout to SoFi's 13.7M members planned for 'coming months'.
